_doc: Cap'n Skagg — the Colorado Area Manager. Turns out to be the real thing: an area manager who actively trains his management teams while touring the stores. Duped by Mattie-T's email at first, he sees through it quickly as he gets to know Todd, and becomes the act's mentor figure. Dialogue-only.
name: Cap'n Skagg
title: Area Manager
samplePhrase: I read what Mattie-T sent about you before you ever set foot out here. I tell you what — I'm glad I looked for myself.
